response.sql: WITH nationality_totals AS (SELECT c.nationality, COALESCE(SUM(cr.points), 0) AS total_points, COUNT(DISTINCT cr.constructorId) AS constructor_count FROM constructors AS c LEFT JOIN constructorResults AS cr ON cr.constructorId = c.constructorId GROUP BY c.nationality) SELECT nationality, total_points, constructor_count, constructor_count - AVG(constructor_count) OVER () AS difference_from_average FROM nationality_totals ORDER BY nationality;
